packs.question: Which GOV.UK sources should I check after a baby is born?
packs.answerSummary: This catalogue identifies official GOV.UK starting points for registering a birth, checking Child Benefit and checking maternity or paternity leave, pay or Maternity Allowance.
packs.scope: This is a directory answer based on captured page metadata. It does not decide eligibility, replace current guidance or provide legal or financial advice.

claims.statement: GOV.UK has guidance on registering a birth and obtaining birth certificates.
claims.transformationNote: Deterministically restated from the captured official title and description without adding an eligibility or deadline claim.

claims.statement: GOV.UK has Child Benefit guidance covering rates, eligibility and how to claim.
claims.transformationNote: Deterministically restated from the captured official title and description; it does not decide whether a person is eligible.

claims.statement: GOV.UK has a service for checking maternity or paternity leave or pay, or Maternity Allowance.
claims.transformationNote: Deterministically restated from the captured official title and description; it does not calculate an entitlement.

limitations.statement: The underlying metadata was observed on 15 July 2026 and is not refetched while this page is used.
Eligibility and the action to take depend on current rules and personal circumstances; this evidence pack does not assess either.
These are selected starting points from a bounded catalogue, not an exhaustive checklist for every family or UK nation.
